claims.claim: 2. toolbarActiveTestid fallback :4302 — member list, ordering logic, is the label a non-stop today, what must change to slot season-manage-delete-season between label and season-create
claims.evidence: main:src/routes/+page.svelte:4302-4313. `toolbarActiveTestid = $derived.by(...)`: only TWO members exist, hardcoded (not array-driven, not DOM-order-driven): `if (toolbarRoving === 'season-manage-gear' && gearEnabled) return toolbarRoving; if (toolbarRoving === 'season-create' && seasonEnabled) return toolbarRoving; if (seasonEnabled) return 'season-create'; if (gearEnabled) return 'season-manage-gear'; return null;` — 'last focused, else first enabled', fallback order is season-create THEN gear (comment :4307-4309 explains DOM order = [+Season] first, gear last for ml-auto). season-manage-label (a <span>, not a button) never appears in this function and is excluded from `handleAdminToolbarKeydown`'s roving query (`toolbar.querySelectorAll('button:not([disabled])')`, :4317) since it isn't a <button> — confirmed non-stop today. To slot season-manage-delete-season between label and season-create in roving order requires: (a) it must become an actual DOM `<button>` child of the toolbar element (id=agenda-admin-toolbar) — handleAdminToolbarKeydown's idx-based arrow-key roving (:4317-4319) is driven by live DOM position within that container, not a fixed list, so its arrow-key slot follows naturally from DOM placement; but (b) toolbarActiveTestid's INITIAL/fallback focus stop is hardcoded per-member (no generic array), so a third `gearEnabled`-style boolean + two new `if (toolbarRoving === 'season-manage-delete-season' && enabled) return ...` / fallback branches must be added explicitly, in the position matching its new DOM slot.

claims.claim: 3. Delete mechanics — armSeasonManageSeasonDelete + seasonManageDeleteArmed shared-slot semantics; anything assuming the delete control lives INSIDE the panel
claims.evidence: main:src/routes/+page.svelte. `seasonManageDeleteArmed` state :2210; doc comment :2220-2224 states explicitly 'the SEASON control shares the ONE-armed-context slot every series/event row already uses, so arming the season disarms a row and vice versa'; `SEASON_DELETE_ROW_ID = '__season__'` sentinel :2225; shared arm/disarm helpers `armSeasonManageDelete` :3191-3198 and `disarmSeasonManageDelete` :3228-3234 (both write the single `seasonManageDeleteArmed` slot, used by series rows :3210-3225, event rows, and the season :3250-3267) — genuinely one shared slot, confirmed by grep hits at :3193/:3221/:3229/:3260/:3327(dup)/:3449/:3515/:6038/:6196. On the 'lives inside the panel' assumption: `onkeydown={onSeasonManagePanelKeydown}` is bound directly on the `id="season-manage-panel"` div (:5313), and `onSeasonManagePanelKeydown` (:2616-2618) just checks `event.key === 'Escape'` — it relies on the keydown BUBBLING up from wherever focus sits, so it works today only because the delete x/confirm/cancel buttons (:5325-5387) are DOM descendants of that div (panel closes :6406). If the delete control moves to the toolbar row (a SIBLING of the panel per #222's structure, :5239-5246 vs :5304+), Escape pressed while focused on it would no longer bubble to this handler — a real breakage. By contrast, `armSeasonManageDelete`'s focus management (:3191-3198, :3228-3234) uses `document.querySelector(...)`.focus() — document-scoped, NOT panel-scoped — so it would keep working regardless of the control's location. No other panel-scoped (`.querySelector` off `seasonManagePanelEl` or similar) query references the delete control in app code; the only other reference is the ARIA id-based `aria-controls="season-manage-panel"` on the gear (:5286), which needs no DOM nesting.

claims.claim: 5. i18n — season_manage_panel_label's consumers after the h2 goes; does the panel div's aria-label stay, or aria-labelledby to the card label instead
claims.evidence: Grepped `season_manage_panel_label` across the whole main tree (git grep on the main ref): exactly TWO consumers, both in +page.svelte — the panel div's `aria-label={m.season_manage_panel_label()}` (:5310) and the h2's text content (:5326). Cross-checked messages/{en,et,lv,uk}.json: `season_manage_gear_label` and `season_manage_panel_label` are currently two SEPARATE keys carrying IDENTICAL copy in all four locales ('Manage season' / 'Halda hooaega' / 'Pārvaldīt sezonu' / 'Керувати сезоном') — same pattern #222 already retired once for the gear (aria-labelledby -> season-manage-label span, killing a duplicate aria-label key). If the h2 goes, the RED contract must decide between: (a) panel div keeps its own `aria-label={m.season_manage_panel_label()}` unchanged (h2 removal is purely visual, key survives with its sole remaining consumer at :5310), or (b) panel switches to `aria-labelledby` pointing at the existing `season-manage-label` span (id already present, :5299) and `season_manage_panel_label` is retired as a duplicate key exactly as `season_manage_gear_label`'s old aria-label was retired in #222 — this is unverified/undecided in code today, both are live options, not a fact to assert either way without a ruling.
